brief: A podcast player where episodes are constellations — listened ones glow, series form patterns

dominant_strengths: Evocative cosmic metaphor with glowing/dim stars cleanly maps listened vs unlisted episodes to a memorable visual model
Restrained deep-violet palette with teal accent feels atmospheric and reinforces the constellation conceit emotionally
Player card has a tasteful glassy treatment that anchors the floating canvas without breaking the night-sky illusion
dominant_weaknesses: Constellations are barely legible as patterns — connecting lines are too faint and stars too sparse to read as series
Massive empty center wastes the canvas; no labels, hover affordances, or grouping cues to navigate episodes behaviorally
Nav tabs and search sit awkwardly clipped at the top edge, and player typography wraps clumsily into three lines
fix_priorities: Strengthen constellation lines and cluster stars into recognizable series shapes with subtle labels on hover
Add discoverability scaffolding: legend, episode tooltip, progress glow on partially-listened stars
Fix top-edge clipping of header and rebalance the player card's text wrapping and proportions
rationale.norman_balance: Strong visceral and reflective pull from the metaphor, but behavioral usability collapses without labels, affordances, or navigation cues.
rationale.intent_fit: Conceptually nails the brief's poetic premise but underdelivers the functional layer that would make constellations browsable as a real player.
